dep.name: WolverineFx
dep.purpose: CQRS command/event bus, saga for user provisioning and role sync (Worker only)

PreferredAgentStack.preferred-read-api: ASP.NET Core controllers for MongoDB user/role cache queries (stateless)
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-write-gateway: ASP.NET Core controllers routing user commands to Dapr pub/sub (async, 202)
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-persistence: MongoDB (user cache, role cache, saga state)

wave-level.focus: Bottom-up: MongoDB → Reader (cache queries) + Writer (command routing) → Worker (saga + Keycloak sync)

phase-level.focus: Full regression including compensation and cache invalidation

Testing.mocking-policy: FakeItEasy for Keycloak client; Testcontainers.MongoDB for integration; in-memory Wolverine bus for units

Observability.redaction: Never log email, phone, tokens, passwords, or PII. Redact at Serilog enricher.

DeliveryShape.shape: K8s: Reader Deployment (3+ replicas, query-only), Writer Deployment (3+ replicas, command gateway), Worker Deployment (3+ replicas, saga processor). Dapr sidecar in each pod. MongoDB StatefulSet. Keycloak external managed service. GitOps-driven deploy.
